title: YELLOW FEVER : DESIGNATED VACCINATING CENTRES = FIÈVRE JAUNE : CENTRES DE VACCINATION HABILITÉS

sections.title: FIÈVRE JAUNE — YELLOW FEVER

summary.text: A bilingual amendment to the 1963 list of designated yellow fever vaccinating centres, adding a corporate centre in New York to the United States private and local centres.

sections.extract: CENTRES DE VACCINATION HABILITÉS Amendement à la publication de 1963 DESIGNATED VACCINATING CENTRES Amendment to 1963 publication Etats-Unis d’Amérique Sous n. Centres de vaccination privés, municipaux ou d’un Etat, insérer: United States of America Under II. Private, local and State health department centres, insert: New York (New York): 175 — International Telephone and Telegraph Corporation
